name: biz-milestone-rail
title: Business Milestone Rail
description: Dated milestones on a 3D rail with a progress segment up to the current point; each milestone lands on its narration cue.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: AI may rewrite every content variable within its limits, choose the skin and camera, and bind measured cue times. Colours and fonts always come from the active --ipw-* theme.

variables.label: Milestones (date::title@icon::detail | ...)
variables.default: 2024.03::项目立项@rocket::组建 12 人核心团队|2024.11::封闭内测@lock::30 所学校参与共创|2025.06::公开测试@users::10 万教师开始使用|2026.01::1.0 正式发布@flag::全学段、全学科覆盖|2026.09::国际化@globe::支持 12 种语言|2027::开放平台@plug::向开发者开放 Agent 能力

variables.label: Visual skin
variables.description: Visual language only; colors and fonts always come from the active --ipw-* theme.

variables.label: Camera
variables.description: Camera move with enter, hold drift and exit phases on the composition timeline.

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses content-paced defaults; this is not word alignment.

usage.intent: 沿真实时间顺序把里程碑一个个落在轨道上，并标出“现在走到哪”。
useWhen: Show 3–8 dated milestones in genuine chronological order, optionally marking the current one.
avoidWhen: Do not invent dates or imply duration from spacing; use a roadmap when intervals must be measured.

inputRules.items: 3–8 entries separated by "|": date::title@icon::detail. Title ≤ 10 CJK characters, detail ≤ 18 CJK characters.
inputRules.current: 1-based index of the current milestone, or 0 for none.
inputRules.skin: keynote for calm launches, cinematic for dark stages, editorial for print-like explainers, dot for hardware/AI moods; colours still follow --ipw-*.
inputRules.camera: flat by default; tilt, iso, unfold or dolly only when depth helps the story. The camera enters, drifts while held and exits with the scene.

readingOrder: See the whole journey and the current point

cueBindings.step-1: When narration reaches milestone 1, land it.
cueBindings.step-2: When narration reaches milestone 2, land it.
cueBindings.step-3: When narration reaches milestone 3, land it.
cueBindings.step-4: When narration reaches milestone 4, land it.
cueBindings.step-5: When narration reaches milestone 5, land it.
cueBindings.step-6: When narration reaches milestone 6, land it.
cueBindings.step-7: When narration reaches milestone 7, land it.
cueBindings.step-8: When narration reaches milestone 8, land it.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding clause, restore the whole journey; keep the final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or choose a sparser business diagram; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve the actual required input or report the missing content; do not substitute demo defaults.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once in order; keep authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary instead of stretching speech.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another business diagram or registry recipe whose structure matches the content, split the content, or report the gap.

values.items: 2024.03::项目立项@rocket::组建核心团队|2025.06::公开测试@users::10 万教师使用|2026.01::正式发布@flag::全学科覆盖

example.narration: 2024 年立项，2025 年公开测试，2026 年正式发布。

acceptance: Every active milestone event lands its milestone; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
Inactive capacity slots acquire no cue and render nothing.
Dates stay exactly as supplied; spacing is never presented as duration.
Test Chinese content with 3 and 8 milestones, and reject a ninth.
